    bbolt.fdatasync.specW) (hBegin : bbolt.DB.Begin.spec) (hCommit : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics
    Fs.fsExt] [inst_1 : Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt], bbolt.Tx.Commit_err.spec) (hClose :
    bbolt.DB.Close.specTok) (hclose : ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt
    Fs.fsExt], bbolt.DB.close.spec_owned) (hLogger : bbolt.DB.Logger.spec) (hOptStr :
    bbolt.Options.String.spec) (hModeStr : fs.FileMode.String.spec) : bbolt.Open.spec
  -- `Perennial.EtcdGrove.bbolt.Open.spec`, unfolded:
  ∀ [inst : ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [inst_1 : Fs.FsSemOk] [inst_2 : HasExt Fs.fsExt] [ThreadBoundLe GF (2 ^ 29)]
    [ReceiptBoundLe GF (2 ^ 62)] (N : Namespace) (R : Fs.Roots) (d b : GoString) (dq : DFrac) (j : Fs.Ino) (qc : Qp)
    (h : Fs.NamesH) (mode : w32) (opts : Loc) (dqo : DFrac) (o : bbolt.OptsM) (D : bbolt.Data),
    NameOk b →
      ⊢
        ∀ Φ,
          isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.bbolt ∗
              Fs.osInv ∗
                ⌜N ## Fs.osN⌝ ∗
                  Fs.osSharedInv R ∗
                    Fs.osPathS R d dq j ∗
                      Fs.osCallPerm qc ∗
                        Fs.osNames j (Fs.NameSet.only [b]) (DFrac.own 1) h ∗
                          bbolt.nameHolds h b D ∗
                            bbolt.optsAtNoErr opts dqo o ∗
                              ⌜o.ok⌝ ∗ (⌜o.logger = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∨ bbolt.boltLogger o.logger) -∗
            (▷
                ∀ db err,
                  (bbolt.optsAtNoErr opts dqo o ∗
                      Fs.osPathS R d dq j ∗
                        Fs.osCallPerm qc ∗
                          ∃ oc,
                            crOut j b h (DFrac.own 1) oc ∗
                              ((⌜err = GoInterface.nil⌝ ∗
                                  ∃ γ i,
                                    ⌜γ.ns = N ∧ crIno b h oc i⌝ ∗
                                      bbolt.isBolt db γ ∗
                                        bbolt.boltIno γ i ∗ bbolt.boltState γ 1 D ∗ bbolt.boltCloser γ) ∨
                                ⌜err ≠ GoInterface.nil ∧ ¬Fs.FsNoErr⌝)) -∗
                    Φ (intoVal db, intoVal err)) -∗
              WP
                ((((intoVal (functions go_etcd_io.bbolt.Open [])) (intoVal (Fs.child d b))) (intoVal mode))
                  (intoVal opts))
                {{ Φ }}

theorem bbolt.open_lock [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (B : bbolt.BNs) (N :
    Namespace) (γs : GName) (D : bbolt.Data) (dp db : Loc) : bbolt.dpProt N γs B.bq dp db ∗ ghostVar
    γs (Qp.half 1) 0 ∗ bbolt.boltState { gs := bbolt.mkGs B, ns := N } 1 D ⊢ ghostVar B.st (Qp.half
    1) D ∗ |={⊤}[⊤ \ ↑(bbolt.dpN N)]▷=> ghostVar γs (Qp.half 1) 1 ∗ typedPointsto dp db (DFrac.own
    (Qp.half 1))

theorem bbolt.wp_logger_ne_discard_open (lg : GoInterface) (hty : bbolt.logPtrTyped lg) : ⊢ ∀ Φ,
    isPkgInit pkg_id.go_etcd_io.bbolt ∗ bbolt.boltLogger lg -∗ (▷ ∀ b, True -∗ Φ (intoVal b)) -∗ WP
    ((Convert go.untypedBool go.bool) ((GoUnOp GoNot go.bool) (intoVal lg
    =⟨go_etcd_io.bbolt.Logger.ty⟩ ![go_etcd_io.bbolt.Logger.ty] (intoVal (globalAddr
    go_etcd_io.bbolt.discardLogger))))) {{ Φ }}

theorem bbolt.open_unlock [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (B : bbolt.BNs) (N
    : Namespace) (γs : GName) (D : bbolt.Data) (dp db : Loc) : bbolt.dpProt N γs B.bq dp db ∗
    ghostVar γs (Qp.half 1) 1 ∗ typedPointsto dp db (DFrac.own 1) ∗ ghostVar B.st (Qp.half 1) D ⊢
    |={⊤}=> typedPointsto dp db DFrac.discard ∗ bbolt.boltState { gs := bbolt.mkGs B, ns := N } 1 D

theorem bbolt.boltCloser.congr_simp [ExtSemantics Fs.fsExt] [Fs.FsSemOk] [HasExt Fs.fsExt] (γ γ✝ :
    bbolt.BoltName) (e_γ : γ = γ✝) : bbolt.boltCloser γ = bbolt.boltCloser γ✝
